claims: Backfill can write an older claim's ownership onto an issue someone else now holds: `selectNewestTrustedClaim` throws away comments it can't parse before it picks the newest one, so if the latest claim comment doesn't parse, it quietly picks an older one that does (`scripts/pr/issue-board-backfill.mjs:145-147` and `:117-122`)
The helper's own format leaves out the `Branch:` line when there's no branch (`issue-board-commands.mjs:74`, with `branch || undefined` at `:143`), but the parser rejects any claim without one

The parser rejects a claim with more than 4 lines after the fields, or more than 1000 characters there; the fallback asks that note to say Project #12 fields weren't set, so a long note is enough to make it fail
A later "Released agent claim" comment is ignored, so a released claim still counts
No test covers finding 1 (backfill picking an older claim); all 37 tests pass
If Branch is made optional, `buildBackfillPlan` as written would push `value: null`, and `updateTextField` treats `null` as "clear this field"
Backfill fails when the issue isn't on Project #12 yet: `issue-board-backfill.mjs:223-226` throws, and the MCP fallback only changes labels and posts a comment, so nothing adds the issue to the board

The runbooks tell you to run backfill first (`.claude/skills/doc-garden/SKILL.md:38`, `.agents/skills/doc-garden/SKILL.md:38`, `docs/notes/github-tooling-surfaces.md:105-111`); for an issue not yet on the board, following them step by step hits the error
The test suite doesn't cover finding 2 (backfill failing when the issue isn't on the board)
Formatting (unconfirmed): `docs/notes/github-tooling-surfaces.md:109` starts at column 0 in the middle of a list item; a Prettier check might flag it

1.why: selectNewestTrustedClaim (backfill.mjs:145-147) runs parseClaimComment and drops nulls before picking the newest createdAt. If the latest claim comment is malformed, an older valid claim gets picked and written to empty fields.

2.why: buildClaimComment leaves out Branch when there isn't one (commands.mjs:74/144), and the parser requires Branch at backfill.mjs:119. That is the known P1 at :119.

3.why: isBoundedCloudHandoff (backfill.mjs:68-76) rejects more than 4 lines or more than 1000 chars. The MCP fallback docs ask for a note but don't limit its length, so a longer note makes the claim invalid without any warning.

4.why: isBackfillable needs an open issue with agent-active or in-pr. A release moves it to agent-ready/needs-grooming, so a released claim is refused unless the issue is claimed again, which posts a newer claim comment.

5.why: Only says a test is missing for claim 1; names no defect of its own (the 37 tests do pass).

6.why: Hypothetical about a future change (Branch made optional). As the code stands, metadata always has Branch, so no null write can happen.

7.why: readSnapshot throws when findIssueProjectItem returns nothing (backfill.mjs:223-226). Backfill never adds the item; only sync/ensureProjectItem does (projects.mjs:308).

8.why: SKILL.md:38 and github-tooling-surfaces.md:105-112 say to run backfill first and sync afterwards. Sync is the step that adds a missing issue to the board, so for an issue not yet on the board, backfill throws before sync ever runs.

9.why: Only a missing test for claim 7; no separate defect (the tests stub findIssueProjectItem to return 'item').

10.why: github-tooling-surfaces.md:108-109 wraps the `Claim ID` code span so 'ID`' starts at column 0 inside the list item. That is the known docs maintainability note at :112.
